10 Configuration specification
E2E Library, like all AUTOSAR libraries, has no configuration options. All the infor-
mation needed for execution of Library functions is passed at runtime by function
parameters. For the functions E2E_PXXProtect() and E2E_PXXCheck(), one of the
parameters is Config, which contains the options for the protection of Data.
[SWS_E2E_00037]
Upstream requirements: SRS_LIBS_00001
⌈The E2E library shall not have any configuration options.⌋
